warranty.notes: Australia: 60% of usable energy at 10 years or 16.45 MWh life cycle discharge per 5 kWh battery pack, whichever comes first. Counted from installation (the policy's start of 180 days after shipment is ignored). The power module (LUNA2000-5KW-C0) has its own time-only 10-year warranty. Requires a FusionSolar connection.

sources.title: Huawei Residential Smart PV Warranty Policy (Global), Issue 04

notes: LUNA2000-5/10/15-S0: one LUNA2000-5KW-C0 power module with 1-3 LUNA2000-5-E0 battery modules of 5 kWh, 100% usable; up to 3 modules per inverter and normally up to 3 inverters in a plant. No longer sold in Australia (since Feb 2024); iStore modules are compatible.
